## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 19 sept 2026 - 19 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Frank Erasmus_, 19 sept 2026, 5/5: "Fantastic app, I tried them all, even the expensive ones. This app gives me everything and more and it is for free! Thank you for the best running app around Decathlon"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 26 abr 2026 - 11 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Mary O Keeffe_, 8 jun 2026, 1/5: "Was logged out, tried to log back in and got stuck on the "Welcome" page where I need to input my details like name, gender and date of birth. I click "Next" but nothing happens. I cannot sign in to access my training. This is highly dissapointing as I cannot continue with my training and fear it will impact my progress. Will be switching to a different app with less bugs."
            2. _Felicity Rose Sunderland Hall_, 26 abr 2026, 2/5: "There is a bug on the app. When I enter my birthday in the correct format, it says incorrect format so I cannot sign up and join the plan. Please could you try and fix this as I really want to use this app for my running! I used it years ago and really loved it but fell out of running. Thanks!"
            3. _manu duval_, 11 sept 2026, 3/5: "l'application à bugé 1 ère fois il y a 2 jours : séance enregistrée non visible. ce matin après + de 30 minutes de fonctionnement correct l'application s'est bloquée. un genre de "cafard à la place du temps puis écran noir en partie base . Présence des touches marche arrêt et pause. Aucune réaction lorsque je les touche... 11 sept 2026 - début séance 06h16."
<!--/ir-theme-->
